Manages access control for Google Cloud Platform resources.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `IAMPolicyClient`: Manages Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `IAMPolicyClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleIAMV1

func sample() async throws {
  let client = try GoogleIAMV1.IAMPolicyClient()
  let response = try await client.setIamPolicy(
    request: SetIamPolicyRequest()
  /* set fields using .with { $0... } */
)
  print("Success: \(response)")
}
```

## Requirements

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the
[Requirements](https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-swift#minimum-supported-swift-version)
section in the `google-cloud-swift` repository.

## Installation

Add `swift-google-iam-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-iam-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleIAMV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleIAMV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-iam-v1
```
